description: This file defines a React component called Toolbar, which provides a set of rich text editing controls (like bold, italic, heading, list, link, image insertion, undo/redo) for the TipTap editor instance. It includes UI elements such as buttons and dropdown menus, and exports the Toolbar component for use in other parts of the project.

classes.name: ToolbarProps
classes.description: Interface defining the properties expected by the Toolbar component, including the editor instance and image handling callbacks.

methods.name: Toolbar
methods.description: React functional component rendering a toolbar with formatting controls for a TipTap editor.
